entries.zh: 點——計點、數鐘點；以「點」計時或計數。
entries.en: point, dot; to count points (marks) and hours.
account, reckoning, number; to count up accounts.
to do sums, to reckon; arithmetic.

entries.zh: （疑）按位計數——依算位（位值）核計。
entries.en: (prob.) to count by places; reckoning by positional value.
entries.notes: 西語詞頭 [疑:logaros/lograros]、H「車箕」亦 [疑]，僅能推為按位／算位計數。

entries.zh: 打算盤——用算盤（珠算）計算。
entries.en: to reckon on the abacus; to count with beads.
to count, to make up accounts; to reckon.
to count all together; to total up.

entries.zh: （疑）唱班——逐項唱名點數、報數核對。
entries.en: (prob.) to call out entries one by one in counting; to check off a tally aloud.
entries.notes: 西語詞頭末段 [残]，H「唱班」於計數語境費解，僅按唱名點數推測。

entries.zh: 講古說故事以消遣（字面作「捨傾」，疑）。
entries.en: to tell fables/tales; to entertain with stories.
entries.notes: L 明言 contar fábulas，H「捨傾」[疑] 且 M 對音不穩，中文用字未能定。

entries.zh: 含口算——心算、默算（不假算盤）。
entries.en: to reckon in the head, from memory; mental calculation.

entries.zh: 抽籌——抽籤、以籌計數（西語 las cañas 指籌、籤）。
entries.en: to draw lots; to count with tallies (canes).
to count the watches (hours) of the night.

entries.zh: 算湊——湊算、結算使賬目相符。
entries.en: to settle and reconcile an account; to make the sum come out.

entries.zh: 片——計數薄片狀物的量詞。
entries.en: classifier for thin, flat things (slices, pieces).
entries.notes: L 末段 [残]、R [疑:giĕn/piĕn]，量詞義由 H「片」與 L「cosas delgadas」互證。

entries.zh: 庫官——庫房（賬房）主管、司庫官員。
entries.en: official of the counting-house; treasury officer.

entries.zh: 庫吏——庫房吏員；亦指賬房、貨棧。
entries.en: clerk of the counting-house; the counting-house or warehouse itself.

entries.zh: 單——賬單、清單；核計舊賬的量詞。
entries.en: bill, itemized list; classifier for going over an account.
entries.notes: R 欄 T99 污損、M [疑:tōa/fōa]，義由 H「單」與 L「quenta pasada」推得。

entries.zh: （疑）點眷——逐項點算核對（字面「點眷」，疑為「點審」）。
entries.en: (prob.) to check off and verify item by item; to count a fixed equal sum.
entries.notes: L [疑:gums/sumas]、H [疑:眷/審]，語義未能定奪。
